representation_decision.A: JAGS4.3.2 centered physical latent model with original item-by-item Bernoulli likelihood
representation_decision.B: JAGS4.3.2 SAME centered physical latent model and priors, canonical response-pattern log kernel for each known observed score, incorporated as observed zero~Poisson(1-log_kernel)
representation_decision.departure_from_previous_proposal: This is two likelihood representations using the same JAGS/rjags backend, not two independent engines. It tests implementation/graph efficiency and posterior consistency; it does not provide independent engine validation. A true alternate backend remains optional and unimplemented.
representation_decision.target_identity: For scoreS and fixed observed-item mask/difficulties choose one canonical binary pattern withS successes. Its log kernel differs from the actual item-pattern log likelihood by a known constant in theta and all latent-model parameters. The normalized score likelihood differs by another known fixed-calibration constant. The zeros trick contributes exp(-1)*canonical_pattern_probability per individual; the exp(-number_of_individuals) factor is also constant. Identical priors and latent law therefore give the same normalized posterior.
representation_decision.numerical_requirement: Compute log successes as -softplus(-eta) and failures as -softplus(eta) without subtracting two large nearly equal totals. Each term is nonpositive, so Poisson mean1-log_kernel >=1 for finite valid states. Invalid/nonfinite states must be surfaced, never silently clipped into the model.
limits: Known calibration only; estimating b makes dropped constants parameter dependent.
Rasch unit discrimination/local independence only; unequal OPLM slopes are not covered by unweighted total score.
Retain each individual observed mask and corresponding difficulties; missingness likelihood or ignorability assumptions remain separate.
Canonical kernel and zeros likelihood are not normalized score probabilities; restore known constants for predictive score PMFs, marginal likelihood or deviance comparisons.
Dropping item likelihood nodes need not speed JAGS: denominator/softplus work still depends on J and sampler assignments may change. No speedup is asserted.

posterior_consistency.summary: Posterior mean, same fixed dataset, priors and physical estimands. ve denotes exp(beta0), conditional environmental variance at A=0.
posterior_consistency.comparison: For each of five means report difference A-minus-B and combined MCSE sqrt(MCSE_A^2+MCSE_B^2), using distinct fixed chain RNG streams and the frozen posterior diagnostic implementation. Report simultaneous approximate Monte Carlo intervals difference +/- 2.5758293035489004 * combined_MCSE (Bonferroni family alpha=.05 across five means within a dataset).
posterior_consistency.failure_rule: Only form these intervals if both complete four-chain joint gates pass and MCSE estimates are finite. An interval excluding zero flags a discrepancy for investigation; it does not justify more draws or reruns within this proposal. A family passing zero-inclusion is not evidence of scientific equivalence. A diagnostic failure leaves comparison unresolved.
posterior_consistency.limits: Intervals address estimated Monte Carlo error conditional on the fixed dataset, not frequentist sampling uncertainty over datasets. Serial dependence, finite-chain bias and unmonitored poor mixing may invalidate approximate MCSE. Deterministic log-target identity is primary. No scientifically justified equivalence margin is asserted. Posterior SD, quantiles and HPDs are reported descriptively with trace/whole-half review; no unprespecified significance test of those summaries.

fixed_failure_and_analysis_rules.performance: Report compilation/adaptation/burn/sampling separately, all requested failures and worst-global ESS per summed chain-process second. Two sequential same-backend batches are not independent engines. Run order/hardware confounding and finite-chain uncertainty limit speed comparisons. No guaranteed speedup target.
fixed_failure_and_analysis_rules.stopping: Finish planned lengths or stop on any fixed resource/identity/error gate. No optional early stopping on favorable significance, no extra samples if MC precision is disappointing, no source-count dispatch. Failure leaves target unfinished and requires a new plan.
